## 2l. Prune redundant supplementary GSEA figures

The GSEA chunks above render several alternative views of the same pathway results
(circular / grid / bar variants and exploratory tier1/tier2 panels). For this project
we keep only a minimal, non-redundant supplementary set: one standard pathway dot-plot
and one decomposition per panel. To restore any extra view, just add its filename to
`SUPP_KEEP`.

```{r gsea-prune}
SUPP_KEEP <- c(
  "bone_pathways_dotplot.png",       "bone_decomposition.png",
  "senescence_pathways_dotplot.png", "senescence_decomposition.png")
existing <- list.files(FIG_DIR, pattern = "[.]png$", full.names = FALSE)
drop <- setdiff(existing, SUPP_KEEP)
for (f in drop) unlink(file.path(FIG_DIR, f))
cat(sprintf("Supplementary GSEA figures: kept %d, removed %d redundant view(s).\n",
            length(intersect(existing, SUPP_KEEP)), length(drop)))
if (length(drop)) cat("  removed:", paste(drop, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Part 3 - Panel volcano plots

## 3a. Build bone / senescence panels

```{r volc-panel}
# Figures by manuscript number. Part I (between-group) volcanoes -> Fig 2 (bone) /
# Fig 3 (senescence). Part II (male-vs-female WITHIN each group) -> Fig 6 (bone) /
# Fig 7 (senescence). Anything unmapped falls through to supplementary/.
fig_root <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "figures")
FIG2_DIR <- file.path(fig_root, "figure_2_bone_volcanoes")
FIG3_DIR <- file.path(fig_root, "figure_3_senescence_volcanoes")
FIG6_DIR <- file.path(fig_root, "figure_6_bone_volcanoes_by_sex")
FIG7_DIR <- file.path(fig_root, "figure_7_senescence_volcanoes_by_sex")
SUPP_VOLCANO_DIR <- file.path(fig_root, "supplementary", "other_volcanoes")
for (d in c(FIG2_DIR, FIG3_DIR, FIG6_DIR, FIG7_DIR, SUPP_VOLCANO_DIR))
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# (panel|contrast) -> output folder + figure-numbered filename.
volcano_targets <- list(
  "bone|AD_spectrum_vs_HC"          = c(FIG2_DIR, "2A_bone_AD-spectrum_vs_HC"),
  "bone|LB_spectrum_vs_HC"          = c(FIG2_DIR, "2B_bone_LB-spectrum_vs_HC"),
  "bone|AD_spectrum_vs_LB_spectrum" = c(FIG2_DIR, "2C_bone_AD-spectrum_vs_LB-spectrum"),
  "senescence|AD_spectrum_vs_HC"          = c(FIG3_DIR, "3A_senescence_AD-spectrum_vs_HC"),
  "senescence|LB_spectrum_vs_HC"          = c(FIG3_DIR, "3B_senescence_LB-spectrum_vs_HC"),
  "senescence|AD_spectrum_vs_LB_spectrum" = c(FIG3_DIR, "3C_senescence_AD-spectrum_vs_LB-spectrum"),
  "bone|sex_HC"          = c(FIG6_DIR, "6A_bone_HC_male_vs_female"),
  "bone|sex_AD_spectrum" = c(FIG6_DIR, "6B_bone_AD-spectrum_male_vs_female"),
  "bone|sex_LB_spectrum" = c(FIG6_DIR, "6C_bone_LB-spectrum_male_vs_female"),
  "senescence|sex_HC"          = c(FIG7_DIR, "7A_senescence_HC_male_vs_female"),
  "senescence|sex_AD_spectrum" = c(FIG7_DIR, "7B_senescence_AD-spectrum_male_vs_female"),
  "senescence|sex_LB_spectrum" = c(FIG7_DIR, "7C_senescence_LB-spectrum_male_vs_female"))
volcano_target <- function(panel, contrast) {
  key <- paste(panel, contrast, sep = "|")
  if (!is.null(volcano_targets[[key]]))
    list(dir = volcano_targets[[key]][1], file = volcano_targets[[key]][2])
  else
    list(dir = SUPP_VOLCANO_DIR, file = sprintf("volcano_%s_%s", panel, contrast))
}
P_THRESH <- 0.05
FC_GUIDE <- log2(1.1)                 # ~10% fold-change guide lines
PAL <- c(Higher = "#D55E00", Lower = "#0072B2", Neutral = "#a6adb7")

# Common protein aliases so labels read "SYMBOL/alias" (e.g. SPP1/osteopontin).
PROTEIN_ALIAS <- c(
  SPP1="osteopontin", TNFSF11="RANKL", TNFRSF11B="OPG", BGLAP="osteocalcin",
  IBSP="BSP", ALPL="ALP", SOST="sclerostin", MEPE="OF45", PCOLCE="PCPE-1",
  MMP9="gelatinase-B", MMP2="gelatinase-A", MMP14="MT1-MMP", CTSK="cathepsin-K",
  OLR1="LOX-1", FN1="fibronectin", PAPPA="PAPP-A", IGF1="IGF-1", IGFBP3="IGFBP-3",
  CDKN1A="p21", CDKN1B="p27", CDKN2A="p16", ESM1="endocan", VCAM1="VCAM-1",
  TNFAIP6="TSG-6", CXCL12="SDF-1", VEGFB="VEGF-B", IL6="IL-6", IL1B="IL-1b",
  SERPINE1="PAI-1", TIMP1="TIMP-1", NEFL="NfL", NEFH="NfH", MAPT="tau",
  SNCA="a-synuclein", NRGN="neurogranin", CHI3L1="YKL-40", APP="amyloid",
  GREM1="gremlin-1", CSF1="M-CSF")
alias_label <- function(sym) {
  sym <- ifelse(is.na(sym), "", sym)
  a <- PROTEIN_ALIAS[sym]
  ifelse(!is.na(a) & nzchar(sym), paste0(sym, "/", a), sym)
}

## Build bone / senescence panels from the curated gene lists in data/.
dict <- read_csv(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data",
                           "SADRC_CSF_SomaScan_protein_metadata_dict.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
read_panel_list <- function(f) {
  g <- trimws(readLines(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", f), warn = FALSE))
  unique(g[nzchar(g)])
}
bone_genes <- read_panel_list("bone_gene_list.txt")
sen_genes  <- read_panel_list("senescence_gene_list.txt")

panel_for <- function(genes, panel) {
  dict %>% filter(EntrezGeneSymbol %in% genes) %>%
    transmute(panel = panel, PanelGene = EntrezGeneSymbol,
              PanelProtein = Target, SomaKey)
}
panel_meta <- bind_rows(panel_for(bone_genes, "bone"),
                        panel_for(sen_genes,  "senescence")) %>% distinct()
cat(sprintf("Curated panels: bone %d SomaKeys (%d genes), senescence %d SomaKeys (%d genes)\n",
            sum(panel_meta$panel == "bone"), length(bone_genes),
            sum(panel_meta$panel == "senescence"), length(sen_genes)))
```

## 3b. Load top tables

```{r volc-load}
out_base <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "dge")  # so Part 3 runs standalone
# Read Part I (between-group) and Part II (within-group sex) top tables.
toptable_dirs <- c(
  file.path(out_base, "glm_combined_baseAge55"),
  file.path(out_base, "glm_combined_baseAge55_sexcontrast"))

read_dir <- function(d) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(tibble())
  list.files(d, pattern = "^toptable_.*[.]csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
    map_dfr(function(f) {
      df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
      if (!"reference_group" %in% names(df)) df$reference_group <- NA_character_
      if (!"comparison_group" %in% names(df)) df$comparison_group <- NA_character_
      df %>% transmute(SomaKey, Target, EntrezGeneSymbol, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val,
                comparison_group = as.character(comparison_group),
                reference_group  = as.character(reference_group),
                n_comparison, n_reference,
                contrast, section)
    })
}

tt_all <- map_dfr(toptable_dirs, read_dir)
stopifnot(nrow(tt_all) > 0)
```

## 3c. Draw panel volcanoes

```{r volc-plot}
panel_res <- panel_meta %>%
  inner_join(tt_all, by = "SomaKey", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(panel, contrast) %>%
  mutate(
    panel_fdr   = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "BH"),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(P.Value, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    effect_bin  = factor(case_when(
      P.Value < P_THRESH & logFC >=  FC_GUIDE ~ "Higher",
      P.Value < P_THRESH & logFC <= -FC_GUIDE ~ "Lower",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Neutral"),
      levels = c("Higher", "Lower", "Neutral")),
    label = alias_label(coalesce(na_if(PanelGene, ""), na_if(EntrezGeneSymbol, ""), SomaKey))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

MIN_GROUP_N <- 5   # skip a volcano if the smaller group has < 5 samples

# Honest display labels: AD_spectrum mixes AD + generic MCI of unconfirmed etiology.
disp <- function(x) dplyr::recode(x,
  "AD_spectrum" = "AD+MCI", "LB_spectrum" = "LB-spectrum",
  "M" = "male", "F" = "female", .default = gsub("_", "-", x))

# Title text per contrast (between-group vs within-group sex).
volc_title <- function(df) {
  panel <- str_to_title(df$panel[1]); contrast <- df$contrast[1]
  nC <- df$n_comparison[1]; nR <- df$n_reference[1]
  if (grepl("^sex_", contrast)) {
    grp <- disp(sub("^sex_", "", contrast))
    sprintf("%s panel | %s male vs female (n=%s vs %s)", panel, grp, nC, nR)
  } else {
    sprintf("%s panel | %s vs %s (n=%s vs %s)", panel,
            disp(df$comparison_group[1]), disp(df$reference_group[1]), nC, nR)
  }
}

make_one <- function(df) {
  panel <- df$panel[1]; contrast <- df$contrast[1]
  n_comp <- df$n_comparison[1]; n_ref <- df$n_reference[1]
  if (min(n_comp, n_ref, na.rm = TRUE) < MIN_GROUP_N) {
    cat(sprintf("  [skip] underpowered: %s %s (n=%s vs %s)\n", panel, contrast, n_comp, n_ref))
    return(invisible())
  }
  cap <- paste0("Filled diamonds: panel-restricted BH FDR < 0.20.",
                if (min(n_comp, n_ref) < 15) "  Small group - exploratory." else "")
  lab_df <- df %>% arrange(P.Value) %>%
    mutate(lab_me = panel_fdr < 0.20 | row_number() <= 8) %>% filter(lab_me, nzchar(label))
  sig_df <- df %>% filter(panel_fdr < 0.20)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(logFC, neg_log10_p)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(P_THRESH), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey78", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-FC_GUIDE, FC_GUIDE), linetype = "dotted",
               color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(color = effect_bin), alpha = 0.7, size = 2.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = PAL, drop = FALSE, guide = "none")
  if (nrow(sig_df) > 0)
    p <- p + geom_point(data = sig_df, aes(color = effect_bin),
                        shape = 18, size = 4.0, alpha = 0.95)   # filled diamond, ~same size as the circles
  p <- p +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = label), size = 3.5,
                    min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1) +
    labs(title = volc_title(df), x = "Model log2 fold change", y = "-log10 P value",
         caption = cap) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "grey30"))

  tgt <- volcano_target(panel, contrast)
  ggsave(file.path(tgt$dir, paste0(tgt$file, ".png")), p, width = 7.2, height = 5.6, dpi = 150)
  cat("  wrote", file.path(basename(tgt$dir), tgt$file), "\n")
}

panel_res %>% group_split(panel, contrast) %>% walk(make_one)
cat("\nDone. Volcano plots in: ", fig_root, "(figure_2/3 between-group; figure_6/7 male-vs-female by group)\n")
```

```{r bone-senescence-bubble-plot}
# ── Bubble plot: bone vs senescence protein correlations ─────────────────────
# Two versions:
#   1. FDR-only: 4 bone x 5 senescence proteins (panel FDR < 0.20)
#   2. Expanded: 15 bone x 16 senescence proteins (panel p < 0.05)
# Bubble size  = |Spearman rho|
# Bubble color = direction (red = positive, blue = negative)
# Star label   = FDR < 0.20 within that cell's panels

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

if (!exists("aexpr")) {
  assoc_in <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "dge", "assoc_input.rds")
  ai    <- readRDS(assoc_in)
  aexpr <- ai$expr
  acovar <- ai$covar[match(colnames(aexpr), ai$covar$SampleId), ]
  cat("  loaded aexpr from assoc_input.rds\n")
}

# ── Helper: compute cross-panel correlation long data frame ──────────────────
make_cor_long <- function(bone_genes_sel, sen_genes_sel) {

  # Filter to SomaKeys present in expression matrix
  bone_keys <- panel_res %>%
    filter(panel == "bone", PanelGene %in% bone_genes_sel) %>%
    distinct(SomaKey, PanelGene)
  sen_keys <- panel_res %>%
    filter(panel == "senescence", PanelGene %in% sen_genes_sel) %>%
    distinct(SomaKey, PanelGene)

  bone_keys <- bone_keys %>% filter(SomaKey %in% rownames(aexpr))
  sen_keys  <- sen_keys  %>% filter(SomaKey %in% rownames(aexpr))

  # Extract and transpose
  bone_mat <- t(aexpr[bone_keys$SomaKey, , drop = FALSE])
  sen_mat  <- t(aexpr[sen_keys$SomaKey,  , drop = FALSE])

  # Label columns with gene names
  colnames(bone_mat) <- bone_keys$PanelGene[match(colnames(bone_mat), bone_keys$SomaKey)]
  colnames(sen_mat)  <- sen_keys$PanelGene[match(colnames(sen_mat),   sen_keys$SomaKey)]

  # Collapse multi-aptamer genes to median
  collapse_to_gene <- function(mat) {
    genes <- colnames(mat)
    unique_genes <- unique(genes)
    out <- sapply(unique_genes, function(g) {
      cols <- which(genes == g)
      if (length(cols) == 1) return(mat[, cols])
      matrixStats::rowMedians(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
    })
    colnames(out) <- unique_genes
    out
  }

  bone_mat <- collapse_to_gene(bone_mat)
  sen_mat  <- collapse_to_gene(sen_mat)

  # All pairwise Spearman correlations + p-values
  rows <- list()
  for (bg in colnames(bone_mat)) {
    for (sg in colnames(sen_mat)) {
      ct <- cor.test(bone_mat[, bg], sen_mat[, sg], method = "spearman")
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        bone_protein = bg,
        sen_protein  = sg,
        rho          = ct$estimate,
        pval         = ct$p.value,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

# ── Proteins passing each threshold ─────────────────────────────────────────
DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE <- c("AD_spectrum_vs_HC", "LB_spectrum_vs_HC",
                            "AD_spectrum_vs_LB_spectrum")

bone_fdr_genes <- panel_res %>%
  filter(panel == "bone", contrast %in% DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE,
         panel_fdr < 0.20) %>%
  pull(PanelGene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

sen_fdr_genes <- panel_res %>%
  filter(panel == "senescence", contrast %in% DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE,
         panel_fdr < 0.20) %>%
  pull(PanelGene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

bone_p_genes <- panel_res %>%
  filter(panel == "bone", contrast %in% DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE,
         P.Value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(PanelGene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

sen_p_genes <- panel_res %>%
  filter(panel == "senescence", contrast %in% DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE,
         P.Value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(PanelGene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

cat("Bone FDR<0.20:", paste(bone_fdr_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sen  FDR<0.20:", paste(sen_fdr_genes,  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Bone P<0.05:  ", paste(bone_p_genes,   collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sen  P<0.05:  ", paste(sen_p_genes,    collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Build long data frames ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cor_fdr  <- make_cor_long(bone_fdr_genes, sen_fdr_genes)
cor_pval <- make_cor_long(bone_p_genes,   sen_p_genes)

# Remove self-correlations (shared proteins that appear on both axes)
cor_fdr <- cor_fdr %>%
  mutate(rho  = ifelse(bone_protein == sen_protein, NA, rho),
         pval = ifelse(bone_protein == sen_protein, NA, pval))

cor_pval <- cor_pval %>%
  mutate(rho  = ifelse(bone_protein == sen_protein, NA, rho),
         pval = ifelse(bone_protein == sen_protein, NA, pval))

# Mark which cells have FDR < 0.20 proteins on both axes
cor_fdr <- cor_fdr %>%
  mutate(
    is_fdr_bone = bone_protein %in% bone_fdr_genes,
    is_fdr_sen  = sen_protein  %in% sen_fdr_genes,
    sig_label   = ifelse(is_fdr_bone & is_fdr_sen, "*", "")
  )

cor_pval <- cor_pval %>%
  mutate(
    is_fdr_bone = bone_protein %in% bone_fdr_genes,
    is_fdr_sen  = sen_protein  %in% sen_fdr_genes,
    # Star if BOTH proteins are FDR significant
    sig_label   = ifelse(is_fdr_bone & is_fdr_sen, "*", ""),
    # Shade background of FDR-sig cells differently
    cell_type   = case_when(
      is_fdr_bone & is_fdr_sen ~ "both FDR",
      is_fdr_bone | is_fdr_sen ~ "one FDR",
      TRUE                     ~ "p only"
    )
  )

# ── Shared axis ordering: FDR proteins first, then p-only, alphabetical ─────
order_proteins <- function(genes, fdr_genes) {
  fdr  <- sort(intersect(genes, fdr_genes))
  ponly <- sort(setdiff(genes, fdr_genes))
  c(fdr, ponly)
}

bone_order_fdr  <- order_proteins(bone_fdr_genes, bone_fdr_genes)
sen_order_fdr   <- order_proteins(sen_fdr_genes,  sen_fdr_genes)
bone_order_pval <- order_proteins(bone_p_genes,   bone_fdr_genes)
sen_order_pval  <- order_proteins(sen_p_genes,    sen_fdr_genes)

cor_fdr <- cor_fdr %>%
  mutate(
    bone_protein = factor(bone_protein, levels = rev(bone_order_fdr)),
    sen_protein  = factor(sen_protein,  levels = sen_order_fdr)
  )

cor_pval <- cor_pval %>%
  mutate(
    bone_protein = factor(bone_protein, levels = rev(bone_order_pval)),
    sen_protein  = factor(sen_protein,  levels = sen_order_pval)
  )

# ── Shared ggplot theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bubble_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40")
  )

# ── Version 1: FDR only (4 bone x 5 senescence) ─────────────────────────────
p_fdr <- ggplot(cor_fdr, aes(x = sen_protein, y = bone_protein)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs(rho), fill = rho), shape = 21,
             color = "grey30", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 5, vjust = 0.5, nudge_y = 0,
            color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#2b6cb0",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#c1432b",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-1, 1),
    name     = "Spearman\nrho"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range  = c(2, 14),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name   = "|rho|",
    breaks = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Bone vs. Senescence protein correlations",
    subtitle = "Proteins significant at panel FDR < 0.20 in at least one disease contrast",
    x        = "Senescence proteins",
    y        = "Bone proteins"
  ) +
  bubble_theme

ggsave(
  file.path(EXPLORATORY_PLOT_DIR, "bone_senescence_sig_protein_bubble_fdr.png"),
  p_fdr, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 150
)
cat("  wrote bone_senescence_sig_protein_bubble_fdr.png\n")

# ── Version 2: P<0.05 expanded (15 bone x 16 senescence) ───────────────────
# Add background shading to highlight FDR-significant region
# Use a separator line between FDR and p-only proteins
n_fdr_sen  <- length(sen_fdr_genes)
n_fdr_bone <- length(bone_fdr_genes)

p_pval <- ggplot(cor_pval, aes(x = sen_protein, y = bone_protein)) +
  # Background rectangle highlighting FDR x FDR region
```

```{r bone-senescence-network-plot-expanded}
# ── Network plot: expanded p<0.05 version (for comparison with FDR-only) ─────

if (!requireNamespace("igraph",  quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("igraph")
if (!requireNamespace("ggraph",  quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggraph")
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

if (!exists("aexpr")) {
  assoc_in <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "dge", "assoc_input.rds")
  ai    <- readRDS(assoc_in)
  aexpr <- ai$expr
  acovar <- ai$covar[match(colnames(aexpr), ai$covar$SampleId), ]
}

if (!exists("make_cor_long")) {
  make_cor_long <- function(bone_genes_sel, sen_genes_sel) {
    bone_keys <- panel_res %>%
      filter(panel == "bone", PanelGene %in% bone_genes_sel) %>%
      distinct(SomaKey, PanelGene) %>% filter(SomaKey %in% rownames(aexpr))
    sen_keys <- panel_res %>%
      filter(panel == "senescence", PanelGene %in% sen_genes_sel) %>%
      distinct(SomaKey, PanelGene) %>% filter(SomaKey %in% rownames(aexpr))
    bone_mat <- t(aexpr[bone_keys$SomaKey, , drop = FALSE])
    sen_mat  <- t(aexpr[sen_keys$SomaKey,  , drop = FALSE])
    colnames(bone_mat) <- bone_keys$PanelGene[match(colnames(bone_mat), bone_keys$SomaKey)]
    colnames(sen_mat)  <- sen_keys$PanelGene[match(colnames(sen_mat),   sen_keys$SomaKey)]
    collapse_to_gene <- function(mat) {
      genes <- colnames(mat)
      out <- sapply(unique(genes), function(g) {
        cols <- which(genes == g)
        if (length(cols) == 1) return(mat[, cols])
        matrixStats::rowMedians(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
      })
      colnames(out) <- unique(genes); out
    }
    bone_mat <- collapse_to_gene(bone_mat)
    sen_mat  <- collapse_to_gene(sen_mat)
    rows <- list()
    for (bg in colnames(bone_mat)) {
      for (sg in colnames(sen_mat)) {
        ct <- cor.test(bone_mat[, bg], sen_mat[, sg], method = "spearman")
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          bone_protein = bg, sen_protein = sg,
          rho = ct$estimate, pval = ct$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
    }
    bind_rows(rows)
  }
}

DISEASE_CONTRASTS_USE <- c("AD_spectrum_vs_HC", "LB_spectrum_vs_HC",

  pull(PanelGene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

  filter(bone_protein != sen_protein)

# Only draw edges where |rho| >= 0.20 to reduce hairball effect
RHO_THRESHOLD <- 0.12   # lowered from 0.20 to include MMP10 edges
edges <- cor_df %>%
  filter(abs(rho) >= RHO_THRESHOLD) %>%
  rename(from = bone_protein, to = sen_protein) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(rho > 0, "positive", "negative"),
    abs_rho   = abs(rho),
    # Mark edges where both proteins are FDR significant
    both_fdr  = from %in% bone_fdr_genes & to %in% sen_fdr_genes
  )

cat(sprintf("  Total edges |rho|>=%.2f: %d  (of which both FDR: %d)\n",
            RHO_THRESHOLD, nrow(edges), sum(edges$both_fdr)))

# Node classification

shared_p    <- setdiff(intersect(bone_p_genes, sen_p_genes), shared_fdr)

# Shorten long protein names for display
shorten_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(x == "PPP3CA PPP3R1" ~ "PPP3CA/PPP3R1", TRUE ~ x)
}

nodes <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(name = bone_only_fdr, side = "bone",   sig = "FDR",  stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(name = bone_only_p,   side = "bone",   sig = "pval", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(name = shared_fdr,    side = "shared", sig = "FDR",  stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(name = shared_p,      side = "shared", sig = "pval", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(name = sen_only_fdr,  side = "sen",    sig = "FDR",  stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(name = sen_only_p,    side = "sen",    sig = "pval", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
) %>%
  mutate(

    panel = case_when(
      side == "shared" & sig == "FDR"  ~ "Shared (FDR)",
      side == "shared" & sig == "pval" ~ "Shared (p<0.05)",
      side == "bone"   & sig == "FDR"  ~ "Bone (FDR)",

# Only keep nodes that appear in at least one edge

# ── Layout: 3 columns, nodes sorted alphabetically within each group ──────────
make_layout_expanded <- function(graph) {
  pnls <- igraph::V(graph)$panel
  side <- igraph::V(graph)$side
  n    <- length(pnls)

  bone_idx   <- which(side == "bone")
  shared_idx <- which(side == "shared")
  sen_idx    <- which(side == "sen")

  vert_space <- function(idx, height) {
    k <- length(idx)
    if (k == 0) return(numeric(0))
    if (k == 1) return(0)
    seq(height/2, -height/2, length.out = k)  # top to bottom
  }

  x <- numeric(n); y <- numeric(n)
  x[bone_idx]   <- 0;   y[bone_idx]   <- vert_space(bone_idx,   height = 7.0)
  x[shared_idx] <- 1.8; y[shared_idx] <- vert_space(shared_idx, height = 3.5)
  x[sen_idx]    <- 3.6; y[sen_idx]    <- vert_space(sen_idx,    height = 7.0)

  matrix(c(x, y), ncol = 2)
}
```

# Part 4 - Protein x neuro-marker association heatmaps (Figures 4 & 5)

Figures 4/5 relate each bone / senescence panel protein to **neurodegeneration-marker
proteins measured on the same SomaScan assay** (tau/MAPT, NfL/NEFL, NfH/NEFH, GFAP,
amyloid/APP, a-synuclein/SNCA, neurogranin/NRGN, YKL-40/CHI3L1). No clinical CSF
biomarkers (Abeta42, p-tau, t-tau, NfL immunoassays) exist in this dataset, so these
are **proxy** markers and the associations are **within-platform protein co-variation**,
not validation against orthogonal clinical assays.

## 4a. Association configuration


## 4b. Fit per-pair associations (panel protein ~ proxy + age + sex + group)

```{r assoc-fit}
fit_pair_bio <- function(y_key, biomarker, bc, adjust_sex) {
  d <- data.frame(
    y   = as.numeric(scale(aexpr[y_key, bc$SampleId])),
    x   = as.numeric(scale(bc[[biomarker]])),
    age = bc$age_at_visit,
    Sex = droplevels(factor(bc$Sex)),
    grp = droplevels(bc$group_var))
  d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d), ]
  if (nrow(d) < 10 || length(unique(d$x)) < 3) return(NULL)
  terms <- c("x", "age")
  if (adjust_sex && nlevels(d$Sex) >= 2) terms <- c(terms, "Sex")
  if (nlevels(d$grp) >= 2) terms <- c(terms, "grp")
  fit <- tryCatch(lm(as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(terms, collapse = " + "))), d),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!"x" %in% rownames(co)) return(NULL)
  list(beta = co["x","Estimate"], p = co["x","Pr(>|t|)"], n = nrow(d))
}

DISEASE_CONTRASTS <- c("AD_spectrum_vs_HC", "LB_spectrum_vs_HC", "AD_spectrum_vs_LB_spectrum")

run_assoc <- function(panel_name) {
  hits <- panel_res %>% filter(panel == panel_name)
  cand <- hits %>% filter(contrast %in% DISEASE_CONTRASTS, panel_fdr < 0.20) %>%
    group_by(SomaKey, PanelGene) %>% summarise(mf = min(panel_fdr), .groups = "drop")
  if (nrow(cand) < 3)
    cand <- hits %>% group_by(SomaKey, PanelGene) %>%
      summarise(mf = min(panel_fdr), .groups = "drop")
  cand <- cand %>% arrange(mf) %>% filter(SomaKey %in% rownames(aexpr))
  blocks <- list(
    All    = acovar,
    Female = acovar %>% filter(tolower(as.character(Sex)) %in% c("f","female")),
    Male   = acovar %>% filter(tolower(as.character(Sex)) %in% c("m","male")))
  out <- list()
  for (bn in names(blocks)) {
    bc <- blocks[[bn]] %>% group_by(group_var) %>% filter(n() >= 3) %>% ungroup()
    if (nrow(bc) < 10) next
    grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(proxy = BIOMARKERS, y_key = cand$SomaKey)
    rows <- purrr::pmap_dfr(grid, function(proxy, y_key) {
      r <- fit_pair_bio(y_key, proxy, bc, adjust_sex = (bn == "All"))
      if (is.null(r)) return(tibble())
      tibble(block = bn, proxy = proxy, SomaKey = y_key,
             col = coalesce(na_if(cand$PanelGene[match(y_key, cand$SomaKey)], ""), y_key),
             beta = r$beta, p = r$p, n = r$n)
    })
    out[[bn]] <- rows
  }
  bind_rows(out) %>% group_by(block) %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
}

bone_assoc <- run_assoc("bone")
sen_assoc  <- run_assoc("senescence")
write_csv(bone_assoc, file.path(ASSOC_CSV_DIR, "bone_biomarker_associations.csv"))
write_csv(sen_assoc,  file.path(ASSOC_CSV_DIR, "senescence_biomarker_associations.csv"))
cat("  bone assoc rows:", nrow(bone_assoc), "| senescence assoc rows:", nrow(sen_assoc), "\n")
```

## 4c. Stacked All/Female/Male association heatmaps

```{r assoc-heatmap}
# Column-annotation palettes (Fig 4/5: disease selection contrast + discovery source).
CONTRAST_SHORT <- c(AD_spectrum_vs_HC = "AD vs HC", LB_spectrum_vs_HC = "LB vs HC",
                    AD_spectrum_vs_LB_spectrum = "AD vs LB")
CONTRAST_COL <- c("AD vs HC" = "#1b9e77", "LB vs HC" = "#d95f02", "AD vs LB" = "#7570b3",
                  "multiple" = "#444444", "(panel)" = "#cccccc")
SOURCE_COL <- c(bone = "#8c6d31", senescence = "#3182bd", both = "#31a354")

draw_assoc_heatmap <- function(assoc, outfile, title) {
  if (nrow(assoc) == 0) { cat("  [skip] no associations:", basename(outfile), "\n"); return(invisible()) }
  if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("circlize", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("  [skip] ComplexHeatmap/circlize not installed\n"); return(invisible()) }
  block_order <- c("All","Female","Male")
  assoc <- assoc %>% mutate(row = paste(block, PROXY_LABEL[proxy], sep = "  |  "))
  ord <- assoc %>% distinct(row, block, proxy) %>%
    mutate(block = factor(block, levels = block_order)) %>%
    arrange(block, match(proxy, BIOMARKERS))
  # genes with multiple aptamers -> collapse to one column (mean beta, min FDR)
  beta_mat <- assoc %>% select(row, col, beta) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = beta, values_fn = mean) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("row") %>% as.matrix()
  fdr_mat <- assoc %>% select(row, col, fdr) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = fdr, values_fn = min) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("row") %>% as.matrix()
  rl <- ord$row[ord$row %in% rownames(beta_mat)]
  beta_mat <- beta_mat[rl, , drop = FALSE]
  fdr_mat  <- fdr_mat[rl, colnames(beta_mat), drop = FALSE]
  block_split <- factor(ord$block[match(rownames(beta_mat), ord$row)], levels = block_order)
  row_labels  <- unname(PROXY_LABEL[ord$proxy[match(rownames(beta_mat), ord$row)]])
  mx <- max(0.3, abs(beta_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-mx, 0, mx), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

  # Per-column annotation: which disease contrast selected the protein, and its panel source.
  cols_g <- colnames(beta_mat)
  sel_map <- panel_res %>% filter(contrast %in% names(CONTRAST_SHORT), panel_fdr < ASSOC_FDR) %>%
    distinct(PanelGene, contrast)
  sel_for <- function(g) {
    v <- unique(CONTRAST_SHORT[sel_map$contrast[sel_map$PanelGene == g]])
    if (length(v) == 0) "(panel)" else if (length(v) == 1) unname(v) else "multiple" }
  src_for <- function(g) {
    b <- g %in% bone_genes; sset <- g %in% sen_genes
    if (b && sset) "both" else if (b) "bone" else "senescence" }
  con_vec <- vapply(cols_g, sel_for, character(1))
  src_vec <- vapply(cols_g, src_for, character(1))
  top_ann <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    `disease contrast` = con_vec, `source` = src_vec,
    col = list(`disease contrast` = CONTRAST_COL[unique(con_vec)],
               `source` = SOURCE_COL[unique(src_vec)]),
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    simple_anno_size = grid::unit(3.5, "mm"))

  png(outfile, width = max(7.5, ncol(beta_mat) * 0.34 + 4.2),
      height = max(4.8, nrow(beta_mat) * 0.32 + 2.2), units = "in", res = 150)
  ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    beta_mat, name = "beta (std)", col = col_fun, top_annotation = top_ann,
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = TRUE, row_split = block_split,
    row_labels = row_labels, row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7), row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold"),
    column_title = title, column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 10),
    rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.4),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      if (!is.na(fdr_mat[i, j]) && fdr_mat[i, j] < ASSOC_FDR)
        grid::grid.text("*", x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")) })
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht)
  dev.off()
  cat("  wrote", basename(outfile), "\n")
}
draw_assoc_heatmap(bone_assoc, file.path(FIG4_DIR, "4_bone_panel_vs_neuromarkers_heatmap.png"),
  "Bone panel x CSF Lumipulse biomarkers (* FDR<0.20)")
draw_assoc_heatmap(sen_assoc, file.path(FIG5_DIR, "5_senescence_panel_vs_neuromarkers_heatmap.png"),
  "Senescence panel x CSF Lumipulse biomarkers (* FDR<0.20)")
```
